The fungi consist of several upright, slender, cylindrical branches that fork occasionally, with some tips appearing slightly flattened or split.

It has a slight 'waxy' or plastic-like sheen inconsistent with the matte finish described in taxonomy.

The tip of the tallest branch on the right seems to merge indistinctly with the background blur. The edge definition collapses rather than terminating in a sharp tip, suggesting a generation artifact where the object fades into the bokeh incorrectly.
